metadata.question: Did Wilmington, North Carolina receive at least 90 inches of rainfall during the year of 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Location: Wilmington, North Carolina (coordinates: ~34.22°N, 77.95°W) - Time period: Year 2018 (2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31) - Dataset: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - a standard daily rainfall dataset - Alternative: MERRA-2 if CHIRPS fails 2. **Masking strategy**: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation data (CHIRPS is station-based and satellite-derived, already processed) - Sum all daily rainfall values for the entire year 2018 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid answer: Sum of annual rainfall ≥ 90 inches → A (Yes) - Valid answer: Sum of annual rainfall < 90 inches → B (No) - C1: No data available for 2018 in Wilmington area - C2: Data exists but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation fails (NaN, None, or out-of-range values) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Wilmington, North Carolina geometry const wilmingtonCoords = [-77.95, 34.22]; const point = ee.Geometry.Point(wilmingtonCoords); const buffer = point.buffer(50000); // 50 km buffer for robustness // 2. Define time period: 2018 const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2018-12-31'; // 3. Load CHIRPS daily rainfall data let collection = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(buffer); // Check if collection is empty const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images Available: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No CHIRPS data found for 2018 in Wilmington area.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Sum all daily precipitation for the year (convert mm to inches) const totalPrecip = collection .reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('precipitation') .getInfo(); // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = totalPrecip / 25.4; // 5. Validate result console.log(`Total 2018 Precipitation: ${totalPrecip?.toFixed(2) || 'None'} mm`); console.log(`Total 2018 Precipitation: ${precipInches?.toFixed(2) || 'None'} inches`); // Check for null or invalid values if (totalPrecip === null || totalPrecip === undefined || isNaN(precipInches)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid data.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Determine answer: >= 90 inches? const threshold = 90; console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold} inches`); if (precipInches >= threshold) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
